## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Style / Design Polish (CSS, contrast, layout, responsiveness)
- [ ] Performance improvement / refactor
- [ ] Tests (adding missing tests or fixing existing tests)

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and conventions of this project.
- [ ] `npm --prefix frontend run typecheck` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] `npm --prefix frontend run lint` passes with 0 warnings.
- [ ] `npm --prefix frontend run test` passes (all test suites green).
- [ ] `npm --prefix frontend run build` generates clean production bundles.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if applicable.
